specName: Review MyAnimeList Matches on the Web

FR-001.title: The site MUST serve the review list at `/review/mal`, filterable by status (ambiguous, no match, failed, or all three, the default), in the CLI list's order.

FR-003.title: Picking a candidate or entering a MyAnimeList id or `myanimelist.net/anime/{id}` link MUST set the season's match exactly as `mal-set` does: fetch the anime onc

FR-004.title: Marking a season "not on MyAnimeList" MUST behave exactly as `mal-none`.

FR-005.title: Asking for a retry MUST behave exactly as `mal-retry` for the season's series.

FR-006.title: The CLI commands and the web actions MUST call the same shared functions, so their behaviour cannot drift.

FR-007.title: The manual view MUST list the manual decisions, and sending one back MUST make it a pending automatic match again.

FR-008.title: Only a signed-in user whose username is listed in the `Frunchy:Operators` setting MAY see the pages or take an action. Everyone else MUST get the site's not-fou

FR-009.title: Every action MUST be a form post that passes the site's existing forgery protection and a rate limit, and MUST answer with a redirect back to the page with a no

FR-010.title: Every action MUST be recorded in the operator's security activity.

FR-011.title: An action on a season that no longer needs it, a malformed id or link, or an unknown season MUST change nothing and show a notice saying why.

FR-012.title: The account page MUST show a link to the review page to operators only.

FR-013.title: The pages MUST use the shared design system and components. Every visible text MUST come from the site's English and Spanish texts. The pages MUST work from 360

FR-014.title: No new stored tables; no change to the extension's API; tests MUST NOT call the real MyAnimeList service.

expectations: no operator role column or operator management page
no paging of the review list
context: area: Infrastructure (MalCatalog, WebAuth, SecurityEvents, AccountActions pattern)
area: Handlers/Account (AccountPage) and a new Handlers/Review slice
constraint: antiforgery via WebAuth.readValidatedForm, rate limits, security events in the action transaction
constraint: tests never call real MyAnimeList (FakeMal)
intent: Operator-only web pages to review and fix MyAnimeList matches, sharing the CLI command logic

decisions.decision: Operators = usernames in Frunchy:Operators, read per request; username loaded with the existing per-request user lookup
decisions.why: no schema change, no extra query, rotates with config
decisions.rejected: cookie claim (stale) or role column (out of scope)

decisions.decision: requireOperator runs before readValidatedForm on every POST and answers 404
decisions.why: the forgery check fails inside readValidatedForm, so outsiders get the same 404 and the endpoints stay hidden

decisions.decision: Shared actions in Infrastructure/MalActions.fs with an expect guard checked FOR UPDATE in the write transaction
decisions.why: CLI/web parity (FR-006) and no clobbering on stale forms

decisions.decision: New mal-auto CLI command for back-to-automatic
decisions.why: parity: every web action has a CLI twin

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and contract for operator-only review pages with shared CLI/web actions
plan.key_finding: writeManual and retry are unconditional and nothing sends a manual row back to automatic

tasks.summary: 16 tasks: setup, 6 foundational (shared actions, auth, events, texts, CLI, parity tests), US1+US3 (4), US2 (2), polish (3)

approach: Move mal-set/none/retry into Infrastructure/MalActions.fs with an expect guard, add back-to-automatic (and mal-auto). A Handlers/Review/MalReview.fs slice serves /review/mal to usernames in Frunchy:Operators only; everyone else gets 404 before any forgery check.

T001.did: Registered MalActions, MalReview, MalAuto and three test files as minimal modules

T002.did: MalActions: Expect guard with FOR UPDATE, setMatch, setNone, retry, backToAutomatic; MalCatalog.writeManualIn shares the transaction

T003.did: WebAuth username in Items, currentUsername, isOperator; Layout.requireOperator answers 404 for non-operators

T005.did: Review texts and four security event labels in en and es

T006.did: mal-set, mal-none, mal-retry call MalActions with Any; new mal-auto registered in the CLI

T007.did: MalActionsParityTests: CLI vs shared action parity for set, none, retry, auto; Open/Manual refusals; Unavailable without client id
